infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to camera to take construction site photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app needs location access to add GPS coordinates to photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: This app needs location access to continuously track your position while taking photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: This app needs access to save photos to your photo library.
